additional_info.subject: RE: ID0390191-DC/Si-D/MC-[Y2/R9 313202799063] Touchscreen is not working CRM:00642001792
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We hope this message finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue where the touchscreen remains non-functional despite multiple charger reboots, we recommend the following steps during the planned site visit:
Actions to Perform On-Site:
Connection Inspection:
Verify all connections between
KF1
and
PH2
to ensure there are no loose connections.
Confirm the integrity of
DPP
and
USB connections
for the OC display and touchscreen functionality.
Voltage Check:
Measure the supply voltage and ensure it is delivering a stable
24V
.
Cable Testing:
Swap the
DPP
and
USB cables
with known working ones to rule out cable faults.
Firmware Validation:
Ensure the
D-Logic controller
is updated to the latest firmware.
Electrical & Wiring Checks:
Verify if
FC-12
in the automation area has tripped.
Inspect all wiring associated with the
HMI
and
D-Logic controller
for potential issues.
PCB Handling:
During updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is firmly connected. Handle the flat ribbon cable with care to avoid damage.
Site Visit Preparation:
Please ensure the spare parts HMI, DPP and USB cable are available during the visit for replacement, if necessary
For guidance, refer to the attached HMI schematic with marked components and additionally refer KA if all the schematic has been checked from your side.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Screen Upside Down_HMI Touch Repsonse - Dynamics 365
When ordering spare parts, please consider the type of existing control panel to ensure compatibility with the new HMI.
For your reference, kindly review the parts listed below.
If you require any further assistance or clarification, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
